tasks.completion_summary: Created e2e test infrastructure with 6 helper functions, 3 test suites (9 subtests), 4 well-behaved and 7 poorly-behaved fixture scripts using socat for port binding

Added 3 e2e tests (PnpmWatch, Vitest, DotnetWatch) verifying single-script autostart lifecycle with full data structure verification of ProcessManager, ScriptRegistry, atomic state, PID tracking, RingBuffer output, and post-stop cleanup

Added 2 e2e tests for multi-script autostart: DependencyOrder verifies 3-script topological ordering with dependency timestamps, concurrent layer-0 starts, ActiveCount=3, all ProcessManager/ScriptRegistry/RingBuffer entries; PartialFailure verifies error reporting for invalid commands while remaining scripts start, and proxy skip for failed script linkage

Added 2 e2e tests for idempotent autostart and session lifecycle: SecondSessionJoins verifies PID stability on second session join, observer count tracking, ownership preservation, process survival after non-owner disconnect, and process stop after last owner disconnect; RestartsAfterAllDisconnect verifies full cycle of start/stop/restart with new PID and fresh ScriptRegistry state

Added 3 e2e tests for SIGTERM-ignoring processes: SIGTERMTrap verifies trap-and-ignore survives SIGTERM but dies on SIGKILL; SIGTERMForwardHang verifies parent+child both survive forwarded SIGTERM and both die on SIGKILL group signal; SlowChild verifies 30s slow shutdown is cut short by SIGKILL in <2s. Fixed bad-sigterm-forward-hang.sh sleep loop to handle set -e with signal-interrupted sleep.

Added 3 e2e tests for poorly-behaved fork processes: ForkDetach verifies setsid+nohup child in different PGID is killed via stored descendants; DoubleFork verifies parent->child->grandchild (setsid) cleanup via descendant scanner; ForkBombLite verifies all 10 background sleep children sharing parent PGID are killed by process group signal

Added 4 e2e tests for poorly-behaved processes with daemon crash recovery: ZombieParent verifies zombie children are reaped on graceful stop; SIGTERMTrap_DaemonCrash verifies SIGTERM-trapping process survives crash but is killed by new daemon orphan cleanup via SIGKILL; ForkDetach_DaemonCrash verifies detached setsid child is killed via stored descendants after crash; DoubleFork_DaemonCrash verifies double-forked grandchild reparented to init is killed via stored descendants after crash
